subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the registered voters cast their vote and 20% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 2144 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Valid votes = 80% (polled) × 80% (valid) = 64% of total registered voters.

Winning margin = 60% − 40% = 20% of valid votes.

⇒ Overall margin = 20% of 64% = 12.8% of total voters.

⇒ Total registered voters = 2144 × (100 ÷ 12.8) = 16750.

**∴ The correct answer is 16750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Polled votes = 80%, Invalid votes = 20% of polled, Winner's share = 60% of valid, Margin = 2144.

 Margin = 38.4x − 25.6x = 12.8x
 ⇒ 12.8x = 2144

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of registered voters be 100x.

⇒ Votes cast = 80% of 100x = 80x

⇒ Invalid votes = 20% of 80x = 16x

⇒ Valid votes = 80x − 16x = 64x

⇒ Winner's votes = 60% of 64x = 38.4x

⇒ Loser's votes = 40% of 64x = 25.6x

⇒ Winning margin = 38.4x − 25.6x = 12.8x

⇒ 12.8x = 2144

⇒ x = 2144 ÷ 12.8 = 167.5

⇒ Total registered voters (100x) = 167.5 × 100 = 16750

**∴ The correct answer is 16750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Problems

Total valid votes are exclusively distributed among the candidates. If there are two candidates and one gets p%, the other automatically gets (100 − p)% of the valid votes.

Successive Percentage

When multiple sequential reductions occur (like polled votes then valid votes), the final effective base is obtained by multiplying the remaining fractions: Final = Base × (1 − a/100) × (1 − b/100).

Winning Margin

The margin of victory is the absolute difference in vote shares between the winning and losing candidates. Margin % = Winner % − Loser %.
